meta.title: Google Ads for UK law firms | Elevate Marketing
meta.description: Google Ads for law firms in England and Wales, on a fixed monthly fee from £1,000. See the numbers from the Norwegian firms we run it for.

topline: Google Ads for law firms in England and Wales
cta: Book a 30 minute Google Ads review

ingress.t: We run Google Ads for law firms on a fixed monthly fee, with no minimum term. One Norwegian business law firm we run it for had

hero.micro: A few questions, about three minutes, so we come prepared.

how.h2: One practice area at a time, tracked to enquiries.
how.intro: A firm that wants more family work does not need more traffic. It needs the people searching for a family solicitor this week, an ad that answers what they are asking, and a page that turns the search into a call. That is the whole mechanism, and it works the same in Bergen and Birmingham. What differs is regulation, competition and cost per click.

items.p: Google Ads reaches people who are looking for a solicitor right now. We bid on the searches that lead to instructions and cut the ones that do not.
Campaigns are set to win form submissions and calls, not clicks. Every week we remove search terms that spend without producing enquiries.
We track each enquiry from the ad to your inbox, and you tell us which ones became instructions. That is how we decide where the budget goes next.

fit.h2: For firms that are growing, not firms that are stuck.
fit.body: The firms we work best with already win work through reputation and referral. What they lack is a second channel they control: enquiries that arrive because the right page was in front of the right person, in a practice area they want to grow.
yes: You are a firm in England and Wales that can put £2,000 a month or more into Google Ads
You act for private clients or businesses in areas such as family, conveyancing, wills and probate, employment, commercial or immigration
A new client is worth {WORTH} or more to you in the first year
Someone at the firm can respond to a new enquiry within one working day
no: Your work is mainly personal injury
Your work is mainly legal aid
You cannot put £2,000 a month into Google Ads
Nobody has time to approve marketing material
fit.note: We check the details you give after you apply.

pay.h2: A fixed monthly fee, from £1,000. No minimum term.
pay.body: We manage your Google Ads for a fixed monthly fee, from £1,000 a month, agreed in writing before anything runs. It does not grow with your ad budget, so we have no reason to tell you to spend more. The fee depends on how many practice areas we run, so we confirm it on the first call.
open: The fee covers campaign build, search term clean-up, ads, landing page advice and monthly reporting.
There is no setup fee and no minimum term. You can stop with 30 days' notice.
We invoice monthly in advance. Payment terms are 14 days.
The advertising budget is separate. You pay it to Google directly, in your own account, and we agree it with you before anything runs.

items.p: A named solicitor at your firm signs off every ad and every page before it goes live. Text and images that the platforms generate on their own are switched off.
We work with enquiry numbers and outcomes. We never ask for, receive or store anything about a client's matter.
Campaigns run in ad accounts you own, tracked in your own systems. If we stop, you keep everything.

rows.status: What Google Ads is set to win
What we bring down month by month

meeting.body: We do not pitch. If you run Google Ads today, we look at your account with you. If you do not, we look at what your competitors are bidding on.

steps.p: You tell us your main practice areas, what a typical new instruction is worth, and what you spend on advertising today.
We go through where the budget goes, which searches bring enquiries and which practice area has the most headroom.
You receive a one page sheet: the changes we would make first and what an enquiry should cost in your practice area.

meeting.closing: You keep the sheet whether or not we work together.

items.q: Your experience is Norwegian. Why would this work here?
items.a: The mechanism is the same: a clear practice area, a clear offer, and enquiries your fee earners want to take. What differs is regulation, competition and cost per click, and we go through those on the first call.
No. We advertise your firm. You decide which clients to take on, and we do not choose or recommend a solicitor. You pay us a fixed fee for managing the advertising, not per client.
A named solicitor at your firm. Nothing runs without that sign-off.
No. We can show you what we have done and how. We cannot promise a number of enquiries or instructions.

A fixed monthly fee for the management, from £1,000 a month and confirmed on the first call, plus the ad budget you pay to Google. We need at least £2,000 a month in ad budget to get results we can stand behind.

items.q: What do you need from us?
items.a: Access to your Google Ads account (or we set one up in your name), a way to tell which enquiries become instructions, and about an hour with whoever runs the practice area.

items.q: What if we want to stop?
items.a: There is no minimum term. You can stop with 30 days' notice, and you keep the accounts and the data.

not-a-fit.h: Thank you. This is not the right fit at the moment.
not-a-fit.p: We work with firms in England and Wales outside personal injury that can put £2,000 a month or more into Google Ads. If that changes, we would be glad to hear from you.
not-a-fit.note: If we have misread your answers, email {EMAIL} and we will look again.

interest.h: Looking for a new website instead?
interest.p: If you would like a fixed-price quote for a new website, press the button and we will email you once, within two working days. A person at Elevate Marketing also reads every application, and may email you once about this if we think it could suit your firm. Every email says how to say no.
interest.done: Thank you. We will email you from {EMAIL} within two working days.
interest.error: That did not go through. Email {EMAIL} and ask for a quote, and we will send one.

cases.note: For the business law firm, enquiries are form submissions and clicks on the firm's phone number, and the 14 months shown are its strongest; later months were lower. For the private client firm we show clicks to call or email, which Google Ads partly estimates. They are not confirmed enquiries. Firms anonymised. Pound figures converted from Norwegian kroner at 0.073. The legal market in England and Wales is different. The method is the same.
